Issue #2: Freedom Five #802: Void If Broken

The Freedom Jet glides smoothly through the skies ove Rook City, past that particular toxic presence on the landscape and towards the snall town of Ravenswood, home of Vanessa Long, the Visionary and Muse. Piercing the clouds, it doesn't look like there's much trouble, certainly not compared to Megalopolis' damaged streets. Main street looks calm and unbothered, the neat rows of suburban homes peaceful. The police frequency shows nothing more than traffic violations disturbing the scene.

Then you all feel a presence in your mind, seeing a familiar angular face, her forehead beasded with sweat. "Hurry." the voice gasps in your minds, "The demons are closing in. I cannot hold them much longer." You get a high level map view of the town, one house on Kirby highlighted in red. Apparently the police don't know everything.

You land the jet in the middle of the quiet street. Children in the gardens behind the picket fences stop playing to stare as you emerge.

"Hey! Look, it's the Freedom Five! What are they doing in Ravenswood?" You can identify the house highlighted on your mental map, but it doesn't look different. It does look a little too small to fit the Bunker suit inside. At least not without removing large portions of the front wall.

"Hurry. They're breaking through." echoes through your minds.

Over to you heroes.
